senses.gloss: paṭhita (nt.; not recorded as noun, only as ppp.), reading, in a list of arts: ˚te LV 〔156.15〕 = Tib. yi ge bklags paḥi mig ḥor, a curiously awkward paraphrase, which seems to mean fixing the eyes for reading letters (?); at least bklags = reading.
-pāṭha, m. (to paṭh-; cf. Skt. pāṭhaka), reader (otherwise only n. act.): vedasupinapāṭhā ye (so divide) LV 〔57.1〕 (vs); śāstrapāṭhān 6 (vs).
